name: Retell AI
tagline: A voice AI platform for human-sounding phone agents, build a call flow, plug in your model and telephony, ship.
verdict: Retell AI is one of the strongest developer-first voice platforms, and its reputation rests on the two things that matter most on a phone call: natural voice quality and low latency, backed by a proprietary turn-taking model at around 600ms. You assemble the stack — LLM, voice, telephony — and get a real builder, an auto-syncing knowledge base, batch calling and simulation testing, plus a broad set of CRM and contact-centre integrations. The trade-offs are the usual ones for this class: component pricing that starts at $0.07/min but realistically lands north of $0.13–$0.20/min once fully specced, and a learning curve that assumes technical staff. Pick Retell if you want top-tier voice quality with control over the stack; skip it if you need a no-code tool with predictable flat pricing and hands-on support.
